apps.name: Grab
apps.purpose: Ride-hailing, motorbike taxis, car rides, food delivery, and some payments in major cities.
apps.traveler_notes: Set up payment and phone verification before arrival if possible; cash is still useful if card payment fails.

apps.name: be
apps.purpose: Vietnamese ride-hailing and delivery app, useful as a backup to Grab.
apps.traveler_notes: Good backup in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, and Da Nang when Grab prices surge.

apps.name: Xanh SM
apps.purpose: Electric taxi and ride-hailing service operating in several Vietnamese cities.
apps.traveler_notes: Useful for airport transfers and city taxis where available; coverage varies by city.

apps.name: Zalo
apps.purpose: Vietnam's dominant messaging app; hotels, guides, drivers, and local businesses often use it.
apps.traveler_notes: Useful for coordinating homestays, tailors, local guides, and transfers.

apps.name: MoMo
apps.purpose: Major Vietnamese e-wallet for local payments, bills, and merchant QR codes.
apps.traveler_notes: Useful to understand, but foreign visitor onboarding and card linking may be limited; carry cash and cards.

apps.name: ShopeeFood
apps.purpose: Food delivery app with broad restaurant coverage in major cities.
apps.traveler_notes: Useful in apartments and longer stays; GrabFood is usually simpler for short visitors.

apps.name: VeXeRe
apps.purpose: Intercity bus search and booking for sleeper buses, limousines, and routes between tourist cities.
apps.traveler_notes: Good for comparing bus operators; confirm pickup points carefully.

apps.name: Booking.com
apps.purpose: Hotel, guesthouse, homestay, and apartment booking across Vietnam.
apps.traveler_notes: Filter hard for recent reviews, air conditioning, location, and window/noise notes.
